$comment: Citation swaps and text fixes from the P1 fact-check. Applied by `npm run apply-fact-check`. Each entry names the fact by week and 1-based index within that week's facts[]. `rewrite: true` means the fact text changes, not just its sources. Nothing here sets reviewed:true - that stays a human act (docs/CURATION.md).

changes.text: Chicks peck at a parent's bill and call to be fed, and it is the calling that brings the food back up.
changes.why: Miller & Conover 1979 (Auk 96:284) found bill-pecking neither necessary nor sufficient in this species; chick calls trigger regurgitation. The classic red-spot experiment is Herring Gull, which this bird is not. Cited via the open-access SORA/Digital Commons record (the Oxford copy returns 403 here); title, authors and year confirmed on that page, the vocalization-vs-pecking finding from the paper's abstract.
